meta.description: Prachyaporn Saensla, early childhood teacher in Chiang Rai — child development, hands-on Active Learning and mental arithmetic.

profile.name: Prachyaporn Saensla
profile.summary: An early childhood teacher with a degree in the field, specialising in child developmental psychology and hands-on Active Learning. Skilled at classroom management and at communicating with young children warmly and patiently while holding their attention. Grounded in mental-arithmetic and finger-counting methods, and eager to train in an institute's abacus programme. Also tutors mathematics, Thai and English at preschool and primary level.

hero.tagline: A teacher who believes every child learns best by <drawn>doing</drawn>.
hero.caption: Teacher Prachyaporn

points.p1: Care closely for kindergarten pupils — daily routines, hygiene and safety.
points.p2: Design lesson plans, run learning activities and make my own teaching materials.
points.p3: Build behaviour assessment plans and observe each child's development, grounded in developmental psychology.
points.p4: Co-organise enrichment projects such as the STEM project "Fun with Natural Colours".

earlyYears.title: Early Years & Child Psychology
earlyYears.body: Whole-child development, communication that fits how young children think, and a classroom where focus feels like fun.

mentalMath.title: Mental Arithmetic
mentalMath.body: Mental-arithmetic and finger-counting methods that train focus, memory and systematic thinking.

tutoring.title: Academic Tutoring
tutoring.body: Primary tutoring (grades 1–6) in mathematics and Thai, with conversational English.

parents.title: Parent Communication
parents.body: Warm, regular updates on each child's progress for parents, and teaching materials made by hand.

teachingMedia.title: Teaching media I make
teachingMedia.label: Behind the scenes of my classroom media
teachingMedia.intro: I cut, laminate and put together the classroom media myself <circle>piece by piece</circle> so the children can hold it, look at the pictures and learn by doing.

activities.label: Teaching journal

student-arts-crafts-fair-73.title: 73rd Student Arts & Crafts Fair
student-arts-crafts-fair-73.summary: Wiang Chai–Wiang Nuea school cluster, hosted at Ban Wiang Doem School. I brought pupils to compete and perform.

lent-candle-offering.title: Buddhist Lent Candle Offering
lent-candle-offering.summary: Ban Wiang Doem School offered Lent candles and pupils declared themselves Buddhists — values taught from an early age.

temple-visit.title: Temple Culture Visit
temple-visit.summary: Preschool and primary pupils learning Thai art, culture and tradition on site.

academic-camp-early-years.title: Early Years Academic Camp
academic-camp-early-years.summary: Early years pupils learned at hands-on stations, such as “Little Chefs: Toast”, making and tasting their own toast.

muay-thai-for-health.title: Muay Thai to Music for Health and Self-Defence
muay-thai-for-health.summary: Pupils practised Muay Thai moves together in the school hall, for good health and as an art of self-defence.

childrens-day.title: National Children's Day
childrens-day.summary: The National Children's Day stage, decked with bunting and balloons: teachers joined by visiting soldiers, with trophies and prizes lined up in front.

wai-kru.title: Wai Kru Ceremony
wai-kru.summary: Ban Wiang Doem School's Wai Kru ceremony, the day pupils pay respect and give thanks to their teachers. The teachers sit on stage with palms joined.

field-trip.title: Field Trip to Learning Sites
field-trip.summary: Ban Wiang Doem School's field trip took pupils out of the classroom to learn on site, with a group photo in front of a giant wooden owl sculpture.

asean-day.title: ASEAN Day
asean-day.summary: Teachers dressed in the national costumes of ASEAN member countries, gathered on a stage hung with ASEAN flags, then cooked together in a classroom.

krathong-making.title: Making Krathongs
krathong-making.summary: Young pupils made krathongs from banana leaves and flowers with their teachers, then posed with the finished krathongs beside a pond.

kindergarten-graduation.title: Kindergarten Graduation
kindergarten-graduation.summary: Kindergarten pupils in graduation gowns with their teachers in front of the Ban Wiang Doem School sign, celebrating the end of kindergarten.

contact.title: Get in touch
